elements.description: Hand work to agents by dragging it onto them – or by click and keyboard.

properties.name: agents
properties.description: The agents work can go to, in the order they're listed (number keys 1–9 pick them)

properties.name: tasks
properties.description: Every task – without an `agentId` it waits under "Unassigned"; the first in each agent's queue is the running one

properties.name: now
properties.description: The clock for the "Busy until" times, in epoch ms – without it the board reads the clock while connected

properties.name: mode
properties.description:
Auto hands every unassigned task to the least busy agent on its own; Manual waits for a drag. Changed by the
user unless a tc-mode-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: suggestion
properties.type: { taskId: string; agentId: string } | null | undefined
properties.description: A suggested hand-off, e.g. from your router: the agent lights up and previews the new time, the task is marked

properties.name: formatCost
properties.description: Formats a cost from rate × minutes – defaults to dollars, e.g. "$0.60"

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-assign
events.description: A task was handed over or unassigned ({ taskId, agentId }: DelegateAssign, agentId null for unassigned)

events.name: tc-mode-change
events.description: The Auto switch was flipped ({ mode }: DelegateModeChange); cancelable

props.name: agents
props.description: The agents work can go to, in the order they're listed (number keys 1–9 pick them)

props.name: tasks
props.description: Every task – without an `agentId` it waits under "Unassigned"; the first in each agent's queue is the running one

props.name: onAssign
props.description:
A drop, a keyboard pick or Auto. The board moves the task at once and keeps it there until `tasks` gives that task
another agent – so `tasks` stays the source of truth, whether you handle the move or only listen to it

props.name: mode
props.description: Auto hands every unassigned task to the least busy agent on its own; Manual waits for a drag. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: The mode on mount when `mode` isn't controlled

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called with the new mode, controlled or not
